metaphors.title: Manhattan Project
metaphors.paraphrase: Co-authoring with AI labs is the Manhattan Project of our time; playing with fire; the sandbox is a cage.

metaphors.title: Novice relaying grandmasters' moves
metaphors.paraphrase: AI-written, AI-digested math reduces humans to the messenger who relays moves between two grandmasters.

metaphors.title: AI vegetarian, AI vegan
metaphors.paraphrase: Natural versus artificial mathematics, as dietary identities; proofs that “grow on trees.”
